process.name: Credit Line Increase Request
process.description: Handles customer requests for credit limit increases. Low-risk requests are auto-approved via Core Banking REST API; high-risk requests are escalated to the Underwriter team with 24-hour SLA monitoring and boundary timer escalation. All outcomes are captured in a full audit log.

elements.name: Credit Line Request Received
elements.documentation: Triggered when a CSR or customer self-service portal initiates a credit limit increase request.

elements.name: Submit Credit Line Request
elements.documentation: Client-Side Human Service (CSHS) coach. Coach template: clir-submit-request-coach.html (included in this ZIP). Captures: customerID, fullName, annualIncome, currentLimit, requestedIncrease, creditScore, channel. Validation rules enforced: requestedIncrease > 0, currentLimit >= 0, creditScore between 300-850, annualIncome > 0. Output bound to tw.local.customerInfo (type: CustomerInfo). Live risk preview computes all three PDD risk rules client-side before submission. Replace submitToBAW() stub with tw.local.customerInfo.* assignments and tw.coach.finish() after import.

elements.name: Risk Assessment Engine
elements.documentation: Evaluates credit risk using three rules: (1) if creditScore < 650 -> status=REJECTED, riskLevel=AUTO_REJECT; (2) if currentLimit > annualIncome * 0.50 -> riskLevel=HIGH_RISK; (3) if requestedIncrease > (annualIncome + currentLimit) * 0.30 -> riskLevel=HIGH_RISK. Default: riskLevel=LOW_RISK, autoApproved=true. Writes to tw.local.riskAssessment. Reads from tw.local.customerInfo.

elements.name: Risk Level?
elements.documentation: Routes on tw.local.riskAssessment.riskLevel. LOW_RISK proceeds to auto-approval path; AUTO_REJECT goes directly to audit and end; HIGH_RISK goes to manual underwriter review.

elements.name: Update Core Banking Limit
elements.documentation: External REST integration: POST https://api.bank.internal/v1/limits/update. Payload: {customerId, requestedLimit, approvalStatus, processInstanceId}. Maps HTTP 200 txStatus -> tw.local.approvalDecision.status. Used on LOW_RISK auto-approval path.

elements.name: Dispatch Audit Event Auto Approved
elements.documentation: Server Script service flow. Formats JSON audit log: {timestamp, processInstanceId, customerId, finalDecision: APPROVED, riskLevel: LOW_RISK}. Outputs to system log or HTTP audit endpoint.

elements.name: Dispatch Audit Event Auto Rejected
elements.documentation: Server Script service flow. Formats JSON audit log: {timestamp, processInstanceId, customerId, finalDecision: REJECTED, riskLevel: AUTO_REJECT, reason: riskAssessment.riskReason}. Outputs to system log or HTTP audit endpoint.

elements.name: Underwriter Manual Review
elements.documentation: CSHS Coach assigned to Underwriter_Group team. Coach template: clir-underwriter-review-coach.html (included in this ZIP). Inputs (read-only display): tw.local.customerInfo and tw.local.riskAssessment. Captures outputs: approvalDecision.status (APPROVED or REJECTED), approvedAmount, approverComments. SLA: 24 hours — live countdown displayed in coach; coach shows SLA breach state automatically. Non-interrupting timer boundary fires at 24h to send manager escalation without terminating the task. Replace submitDecisionToBAW() stub with tw.local.approvalDecision.* assignments and tw.coach.finish() after import. Set processedBy = tw.system.user.name.

elements.name: 24h SLA Overdue
elements.documentation: Non-interrupting timer boundary event. Fires after 24 hours if the underwriter has not completed their review. Triggers manager escalation notification without cancelling the underwriter task.

elements.name: Send Manager Escalation Notification
elements.documentation: Sends escalation email to manager group when the 24h SLA is breached. Includes processInstanceId, customerId, elapsed time, and current task assignee. Does not terminate the underwriter review task.

elements.name: Underwriter Decision?
elements.documentation: Routes on tw.local.approvalDecision.status. APPROVED proceeds to Core Banking update; REJECTED goes directly to audit event.

elements.name: Update Core Banking Limit Underwriter
elements.documentation: External REST integration: POST https://api.bank.internal/v1/limits/update. Payload: {customerId, approvedAmount, approvalStatus, processInstanceId}. Maps HTTP 200 txStatus -> tw.local.approvalDecision.status. Used on underwriter-approved path.

elements.name: Dispatch Audit Event Underwriter Approved
elements.documentation: Server Script service flow. Formats JSON audit log: {timestamp, processInstanceId, customerId, finalDecision: APPROVED, riskLevel: HIGH_RISK, approver: approvalDecision.processedBy, approvedAmount}. Outputs to system log or HTTP audit endpoint.

elements.name: Dispatch Audit Event Underwriter Rejected
elements.documentation: Server Script service flow. Formats JSON audit log: {timestamp, processInstanceId, customerId, finalDecision: REJECTED, riskLevel: HIGH_RISK, approver: approvalDecision.processedBy, reason: approvalDecision.approverComments}. Outputs to system log or HTTP audit endpoint.

elements.name: Auto Approved
elements.documentation: Process ends successfully with automatic approval. Core Banking limit updated.

elements.name: Auto Rejected
elements.documentation: Process ends with automatic rejection due to credit score below minimum threshold (< 650).

elements.name: Underwriter Approved
elements.documentation: Process ends with underwriter approval. Core Banking limit updated and audit logged.

elements.name: Underwriter Rejected
elements.documentation: Process ends with underwriter rejection. Audit event logged with reason and approver comments.

elements.name: Escalation Sent
elements.documentation: Escalation notification dispatched to manager. Underwriter task continues independently.

variables.name: customerInfo
variables.description: Primary customer data captured at request submission. Read by risk assessment and all audit events.

variables.name: riskAssessment
variables.description: Risk evaluation result produced by the Risk Assessment Engine. Drives gateway routing and is included in audit events.

variables.name: approvalDecision
variables.description: Final approval decision captured either by the system (auto-approval) or by the underwriter. Maps Core Banking API txStatus and underwriter inputs.

businessObjects.name: CustomerInfo
businessObjects.description: Captures all customer data submitted in the credit line increase request form. Used by risk engine, banking integration, and audit steps.

businessObjects.name: RiskAssessment
businessObjects.description: Output of the Risk Assessment Engine. riskLevel values: LOW_RISK, HIGH_RISK, AUTO_REJECT. autoApproved is true only when riskLevel=LOW_RISK.

businessObjects.name: ApprovalDecision
businessObjects.description: Final credit line decision. status values: APPROVED, REJECTED, PENDING_UNDERWRITER. processedBy is the underwriter user ID or 'SYSTEM' for automated decisions.
